Messages.Author: Eryn Gabriel Surprenant
Messages.Body:
Not to beat this subject to death but I propose the following house
rule/ fix for Fame:

Allow Fame to be STOLEN from the famous vampire by any other ready
minion, as long as the famous vampire is not currently in torpor.

This would allow several things. First off, it is realistic in the
sense that someone else can steal the limelight, and thus the benefits, of
the Fame. Also it provides a way to get rid of Fame ie. an ally stealing
it, whereby it becomes useless, and then sooner or later getting burned
himself. Lastly, its still a really powerful card but you'll think twice about putting it out when your predator can steal it from you (Hell, he could
even steal it with a Day Op of his own and then go to torpor). Anyway,
I haven't played with this Rule yet, just an idea.

Eryn

PS-that'd be a (D) action.
